justification: Display labels on the assessment page plus the SEPP identifier extraction that feeds the SEPP Requirements card; no eligibility, database or regulatory value changes.

pre_impl.existing_data: Planning Portal 'Class' attribute already reads 'Class 5'; EPI Name carries the full instrument name with its year.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: Old regex assumed the first number after SEPP is a policy number; for named instruments it is the year.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: No new surface; the existing card components and extractor are corrected in place.

falsifiable_check.fails_when: Measured 2026-10-19: with nsw-planning-portal.ts restored from fb4150e5 (the old year-as-number regex), 4 of the 5 tests fail.
falsifiable_check.observed_red: Live page for 6 Berrigan St Winston Hills on 2026-10-19 listed 'SEPP 2022' and 'SEPP 2021' under Assess manually.

functions.name: NSWPlanningPortalService.extractApplicableSepps
functions.input: one Planning Portal layer result with EPI Name, Map Type and other text fields
functions.output: identifiers pushed onto constraints.applicableSepps: known keys, full instrument names, or SEPP_<number> for numbered policies
functions.if_none: no identifier is pushed and the card shows no unstructured SEPP line

values.if_missing: the row shows No, as before

break_it.scenario: A named SEPP arrives in the EPI Name field with its year.
break_it.what_happens: Card shows the instrument name, never a bare year.
break_it.how: named-instrument regex keeps the parenthesised name and year together

break_it.scenario: A map title names a repealed instrument, the Aerotropolis Wind Turbines Map.
break_it.what_happens: No identifier is added from the map title, so no stale instrument is listed.
break_it.how: named instruments are taken only from the EPI Name field

break_it.scenario: Portal acid sulfate class arrives as a bare number like 5.
break_it.what_happens: Row reads Class 5, prefix still added when the value lacks it.
break_it.how: prefix added only when the value does not already start with Class

break_it.scenario: Overlay description differs from its class value.
break_it.what_happens: Both are still shown because only equal values after removing spaces are hidden.
break_it.how: sameValue compares with whitespace removed and case ignored

post_merge.db_reset: No database change in this branch.
post_merge.manual_verify: Yes - after Vercel deploy, 6 Berrigan St Winston Hills: no 'SEPP 2022/2021', 'Class Class', triple '30 km', 'city_of_parramatta', or 'Updated Feb 2026' text.

residual_risk: The overlay title 'SEPP (Western Sydney Aerotropolis) 2020 Wind Turbines Map' is the Planning Portal's own layer name and is shown unchanged; the current instrument name prints beside it.

cross_review.finding: [MEDIUM] nsw-planning-portal.ts applicableSepps may be undefined before push
cross_review.why: every access uses optional chaining (?.includes / ?.push), so an absent array is a no-op, and the only caller initialises it to an empty array.

cross_review.finding: [LOW] named[1] may be undefined before trim
cross_review.why: group 1 is a required capture ([^)]+), so it is always a non-empty string whenever the regex matches.
